android.name: GATEWISE Guard (Android)
android.description: Native Android Guard client featuring real-time YuNet edge camera detection, SFace 128-D cosine match, and HMAC-SHA256 non-repudiation ledger.
android.notice: The official Android production APK is undergoing security verification and EAS build certification. Sideloading development or unverified binaries is prohibited under institutional policy. Contact Campus IT Security or enroll in the institutional deployment pilot.

ios.name: GATEWISE Guard (Apple iOS)
ios.description: Pure native SwiftUI & Swift 6 client with Liquid Glass aesthetic, strict concurrency, biometric Face ID unlock, and offline-first persistence.
ios.notice: Apple iOS applications require App Store Connect, Apple TestFlight, or approved Enterprise Mobile Device Management (MDM). Direct-download IPAs from websites are not supported by Apple platform security. Join the official TestFlight pilot below.

macos.name: GATEWISE Admin Command Centre (macOS)
macos.description: Native desktop Command Centre for campus administrators with live telemetry, access roster control, and cryptographic audit log inspection.
macos.notice: Mount the disk image and drag 'GATEWISE AI Command Centre.app' into Applications. Open via Privacy & Security if prompted on first launch.
